pipeline.modality: Multi-specific, fully human polyclonal anti-thymocyte globulin (Tc Bovine-derived hIgG)
pipeline.target: Anti-thymocyte (T-cell modulation; CD4/CD8 T cells, preserves Tregs)

indications.trial_design: Multicenter, global, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2b in pediatric/adolescent/adult patients (5-40 yrs) with new-onset Stage 3 T1D within 100 days of dx; 159 patients; two active dose levels (1.5 mg/kg, 2.5 mg/kg) vs placebo; primary endpoint stimulated C-peptide AUC at 12 months
key_milestones: Phase 1 positive topline Jan 2025 + Dec 2025; Phase 2b initiated Q3 2025; topline data H2 2027; FDA Type B meeting May 2025 confirmed registrational use of SAFEGUARD

excluded_preclinical: Other autoimmune indications (SLE, RA, MS, celiac) — preclinical platform expansion only
excluded_legacy_terminated: SAB-185 anti-SARS-CoV-2 hIgG (NCT04468958, NCT04469179, NCT04518410 ACTIV-2) — completed/discontinued, no active development
SAB-301 anti-MERS hIgG (NCT02788188) — completed, no further development

SAB-176 anti-influenza hIgG Phase 1 (NCT06435936, NCT04471038) and Phase 2 challenge (NCT04850898) — completed; not part of current active P1/P2/P3 lead pipeline per 10-K (program deprioritized in favor of SAB-142)
